# Static Site Generation

Static Site Generation pre-renders a page to HTML at build time, so every visitor is served an already-built file from a CDN with no server work per request - the fastest possible strategy for content that does not change per user or very often.

```jsx
// A page with no dynamic data source is statically generated by default
export default async function Page() {
  const posts = await getPosts(); // fetched once at build time
  return <PostList posts={posts} />;
}
```

**Key takeaway:** SSG is the default rendering strategy in the App Router whenever a route has no dynamic functions (cookies, headers) or uncached dynamic data fetches.
